_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Any scarab build works -- these are stock built-in L2 replacement policies; no special branch required.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: Sweep of the built-in L2 (MLC) replacement policies via --mlc_cache_repl_policy <ordinal> (the Repl_Policy enum in src/libs/cache_lib.h, cast straight from the uns param at memory.c init). baseline leaves MLC_CACHE_REPL_POLICY at the default (0 = REPL_TRUE_LRU). Only the general-purpose, self-contained policies are swept; oracle/special-purpose entries (IDEAL, SHADOW_IDEAL, IDEAL_STORAGE, MLP, PARTITION, RESTEER, STICKY_PRIORITY_LINES, ISO_PREF, LOW_PREF, VOID) and the custom MARKED_RRIP (needs --td_load_rrip_mark --td_load_rrip_on_mlc) are omitted. Intended as the stock-policy baseline set to compare against the marked-RRIP-on-L2 sweeps. Compare IPC / miss stats vs. baseline with plot_stat_change.py.
_configurations: baseline = default L2 policy (REPL_TRUE_LRU). Each repl_* config forces one built-in policy on the L2 via --mlc_cache_repl_policy <ordinal>. repl_true_lru (0) is an explicit copy of the default and should read ~0% vs baseline (determinism sanity check). Ordinals: 0=TRUE_LRU, 1=RANDOM, 2=NOT_MRU, 3=ROUND_ROBIN, 14=LRU_REF, 15=NRU, 16=SRRIP, 17=BRRIP, 18=DRRIP, 19=SHIP.

repl_true_lru._params: REPL_TRUE_LRU (0) -- explicit default; sanity check, ~0% vs baseline.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
